reviews.comment: I took math 308 honors with Dr. Luhrmann. He is the best math prof I've had at a&m. It's not an easy course, but this his homeworks and exams are very fair. Exams are like the homework. He also provides study guides for exams! Nice prof who cares about his students' success and learning.

Took him in Spring 2021. His lectures are clear and he is passionate about teaching. Since MATH 410 is not an easy course just like all pure math and applied math majors have to take MATH 409, his grading scale is very clear and I was happy to pass that class. Going to office hours and attending help sessions are helpful.
